systeme.alexa.connecte: Amazon account connected: {n} speakers and groups driven by Moli.
systeme.alexa.a_connecter: Connect your Amazon account so Moli drives your Echo speakers (music, volume, announcements).
systeme.alexa.erreur: Amazon is not answering right now: Moli tries again by itself.
systeme.alexa.etape1: Open Amazon's sign-in page, on a computer if you can.
systeme.alexa.etape2: Sign in: password, verification code, it all happens at Amazon. It may ask for your credentials twice, or show a captcha.
systeme.alexa.etape3: You land on a "not found" error page: that is expected. Copy its address (it starts with https://www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding) and paste it below within 5 minutes.
systeme.alexa.aide: Moli never sees your password: it shows up as a "Moli" device of your Amazon account, and keeps an encrypted token in its secret store.
systeme.alexa.officieux: Amazon offers no official interface to drive Echo music: Moli uses the Alexa app's, which may change without notice.

systeme.engie.connecte: ENGIE account connected: prices, peaks and smart charging followed by Moli.
systeme.engie.a_connecter: Connect your ENGIE account so Moli follows your prices, your capacity peak and your smart charging.
systeme.engie.erreur: ENGIE is not answering right now: Moli tries again on its own.
systeme.engie.etape1: Open ENGIE's sign-in page, on a computer. In that new tab, before signing in, open the browser's tools (F12), Network tab, and tick "Persist logs".
systeme.engie.etape2: Sign in: e-mail, password, then the code ENGIE sends by text or e-mail. It all happens at ENGIE.
systeme.engie.etape3: At the end the browser shows an error ("address not understood"): that is expected, the page wants to open the ENGIE app. In the Network tab, click the last "resume" line (status 302) and copy, from the response headers, the value of "Location": it starts with be.engie.smart://login-callback. Paste it below within 5 minutes.
systeme.engie.aide: Moli never sees your password: it only keeps an encrypted token in its secret store. Signing in with the same account in the app or on engie.be closes Moli's session: it will then ask you to connect it again.
systeme.engie.officieux: ENGIE offers no official interface: Moli uses the ENGIE Smart app's, which may change without notice.
